caption: The video captures a close-up view of a burning bed of dark, irregular chunks resting on a wire grate. Bright orange and yellow embers glow beneath and between the pieces, while translucent yellow flames rise over and around them. The solid chunks remain fixed in place, shifting only in how they are occluded by passing fire. Flame tongues curl, split, and merge as their shape and brightness continuously change across the pile. The flame pattern shifts, with a tall bright mass near the upper center becoming broader and more leftward and upward before thinning again. The glowing embers pulse in intensity, while a hot yellow-white flame becomes more visible on the right side. The burning process continues, with the fuel arrangement remaining intact.
